description: This Java class implements an application listener that responds to the shutdown event of the application context. Its primary responsibility is to deregister JDBC drivers to prevent memory leaks upon application shutdown.

classes.name: AbandonedConnectionCleanupShutdownListener
classes.description: A Spring application listener that detects when the application context is closing and performs JDBC driver cleanup to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Triggered when the application context is closed; initiates cleanup of JDBC drivers.

methods.name: shutDowncleanUpThreadAndDeregisterJDBCDriver
methods.description: Deregisters all registered JDBC drivers to prevent memory leaks and sleeps briefly to ensure cleanup completion.
